body.x: NEW YORK, USA (AVING) -- <Visual News> BenQ(kr.BenQ.com) has introduced its new laptop model ‘joybook’ at KES 2005. ‘Joybook’ comes in five models from 12-inch to 15-inch according to its monitor size. It is focused on the multimedia function and users can visit BenQ’s website for diverse contents,

All models but 15-inch models are equipped with ‘Color Shine Display’ on their LCD. As for ‘S72’ series, you can use a remote controller for TV recording, DVD, channel, volume functions. Suggesting price for the models with AMD is about 1,000,000(KRW) while for the models with Centrino is between 1,000,000(KRW) ~ 2,000,000(KRW) <AVING Special Report Team for ‘NEWTECH KOREA 2005’ : Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Jason Lee, Sophia Kwag, Annie Park, Caleb Ma, edited by Daniel Sirh>
